title: Kombucha Cocktails
notes: Simple Syrup is simply 2 parts white sugar to 1 part water heated until all the sugar is dissolved and then left to cool. Make a batch and keep it on hand.

methodSections.heading: Raspberry Kombucha-Ale
steps: Fill glasses half way with chilled Raspberry Kombucha and top up with India Pale Ale. The sweetness of the raspberry offsets the bitterness of the IPA perfectly, which makes for a light, refreshing, distinctly European-inspired summer beverage.
